name: exercise ball serratus wall slide
description: Slide your forearms up a wall on a stability ball to wake up the serratus anterior and improve shoulder control.
instructions: Place a stability ball against a wall and rest your forearms on it.
Step back slightly so your body leans in.
Slide your forearms up the ball as you reach overhead.
Push into the ball and spread your shoulder blades at the top.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your lower back.
